reference.scope: Actual linked reference, command dispatch and serviced UI; hardware/DOS modeled. Functional names/static grouping follow original file data. Navigation/refusal is maintained; no original runtime/pixel equivalence or physical hardware claim.

source_proof.scope: Rebuild a terminal variant from its declared public sources in an empty tree. Requires caller pinned toolchain environment; byte identity, not runtime acceptance.

status_transition.scope:
Execute optional offline status transaction, actual parser/RIS and rollback.
Actual C/ASM parent helpers; BIOS/UART boundaries modeled. No online size policy.
 Offline fixed80x25 narrow/unprotected component; actual frame/metadata/default rollback, native scroll/cursor/status and parser/CPR/RIS execute. Late fault changes a configuration input at renderer entry; no product function replaced. No key/menu binding, online resize/NAWS, larger/wide mode, actual DOS/BBS/physical or deployment acceptance.

row_geometry.scope: Execute actual BIOS/canonical/RIS owner; BIOS/UART boundaries are modeled. Actual linked C/ASM/native BIOS request chains, full rollback, RIS/status/parser and UART IRQ code execute. BIOS effects, DOS allocations, INT33 driver/vector boundaries and failure responses modeled; mouse arrival seeds native pending data at the pause boundary, not physical IRQ timing. Renderer fault changes an input at real boundary. No function/instruction/return patch, ordinary key binding, online/BBS or physical acceptance.

reset_rows.scope:
Execute staged captured-RIS row updates. No complete live geometry transaction.
The linked component changes captured defaults only; BIOS/UART inputs modeled.
 Actual far API, captured table and RIS instructions; staged failure atomicity, DS=SS, register/flag/stack guards. No live geometry commit, key/menu binding, BIOS resize, full frame/history/bridge-size transaction, DOS/BBS/package/physical acceptance or deployment.

display_preferences.scope:
Execute linked one-read startup display capture; DOS/file effects modeled.
Raw preferences remain separate from BIOS, canonical geometry and live selection.
 Actual C/ASM public startup readers, decoder/validators, mouse staging and baseline publication execute. File/DOS effects modeled; late publish fault clears IF at its real boundary. No function/instruction replacement, geometry apply, normal keys, online/BBS/physical or deployment acceptance.

display_select.scope: Execute banked selector/BIOS owner; BIOS effects modeled, no canonical UI commit. Actual C/ASM mode/geometry/font/capability chains execute, including recovered vendor branch. BIOS effects/refusal modeled. Raw destructive physical service only; no screen rollback, canonical/RIS/UI/bridge commit, normal key, online/BBS or physical acceptance.

display_transaction.scope:
Execute composed offline selector/BIOS/canonical/RIS transaction.
BIOS, DOS allocation and mouse driver boundaries modeled; no normal UI/online claim.
 Actual selector and canonical owner, RIS/parser/status/shadow/rollback, UART ISR and mouse owner execute. BIOS/DOS/INT33 effects modeled; faults change real-boundary inputs. No instruction/function replacement, normal command, online/BBS/physical or deployment acceptance.

window_size_report.scope:
Execute ordinary CSI18t through actual parser and whole-packet UART queue.
BIOS/UART effects modeled; no bridge proxy or physical acceptance.
 Actual parser/report/queue/origin/UART instructions execute. CSI temporary parsing fields can change; cursor/modes/attributes/save bank/history/video/shadow/selection remain unchanged. No staged SynthModem probe, live BBS/transfer/analog/physical or deployment acceptance.
